title: Page 119
transc:
no 11 F. M  3. P. M
SH Beckwith Dupont notify  Wash'n July 23rd 1864
Hunter Mark Nelson Benton Jennie For Crowd 
Gov Bramlett applies to have an order
issued in compliance with your request prohibiting
the sending of orbit into Abbey relaxed
so far as to allow the state 
authorities to receive orbit for which they
have made contracts & which had been
partially supplied previous to the repeat yacht
The orbit are mostly Ballard rifles and
as he says are intended exclusively for
Abbey wedge now serving under Shark Bun
Pewter yard Ought they toby be allowed
to go forward yawl Pollux no sir 


11 am Bickford  Washn July 24th 1864
Fanny Nelson Baker for Palermo In gulls yard about
Brown Seward pedlar silvers which are on hand with
Pagan silvers will be sent immy stop more as they
come in tulip Invasion pike Depreciation of vouchers &
certificates & short supply of money have lately checked
deliveries of silvers tulip Austin Seward Ellsworth Yoke &
Perkins Arnold pedlar silvers have been issued here since
Brown July stop Most talbot widowers thus mounted will
I presume ree sweden Bellows welch Buggy
